notes.title: 2/2/2018 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]エンディングをスキップできるようになった。
[*]ルクスの声の減衰を調整
[*]ライティングを調整
[*]入力の不具合を解消
[*]字幕表示の速度を調整
[*]Ｖｉｖｅのトリガーにツールチップを表示
[*]ＵＩの微調整
[/list]

[list]
[*]You can now skip the ending
[*]Adjusted Lux's vocals
[*]Lighting has been adjusted
[*]Various input issues fixed
[*]Subtitle timing has been adjusted
[*]Vive specific tooltips have been added
[*]UI has been adjusted
[/list]
